abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 93 | 550 |
